# minimp3

Decoder headers `minimp3.h` and `minimp3_ex.h` are from [lieff/minimp3](https://github.com/lieff/minimp3). The headers dedicate their copyright and related rights to the public domain worldwide under CC0 1.0; see the notices at the top of each header. They are compiled into Circuit FX Studio for MP3 import and add no runtime dependency.
